row: My name Is Kipp Clark JACSMT; I am an Advanced Clinical Massage Therapist and Chronic Pain Specialist. My company is Alton Advanced Bodywork and I have practices in Alton & Fleet, Hampshire. I set up this channel to provide rehabilitation exercise and self-help advice to my clients, and the general public. I also hope to promote clinical massage, and its role in the treatment of chronic pain & injury.
